name: Caged Sun
oracle_text:
As this artifact enters, choose a color.
Creatures you control of the chosen color get +1/+1.
Whenever a land's ability causes you to add one or more mana of the chosen color, add an additional one mana of that color.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a land's ability causes you to add one or more mana of the chosen color, add an additional one mana of that color.

needs.what: an add_mana_on_tap static whose tapped_permanent.produced may be {"chosen_color_of": "self"}: it fires once when a land's mana ability adds at least one mana of the source's chosen color, and adds one more of that color (the add_mana half already accepts {"chosen_color_of": "self"}, as Utopia Sprawl does). Ideally keyed on a land's mana ability producing it rather than only on tapping, so a land that sacrifices for mana also counts
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_mana_on_tap with tapped_permanent {types: [Land]} matches every land tap, so without a produced filter it would add the chosen color even when a land made a different color (a strictly stronger card). tapped_permanent.produced is read by player_statics._tap_statics through parse_mana_production as a literal mana string, so it cannot name the chosen color; double_land_mana doubles all of a land's mana rather than adding one of a chosen color
